story_type: sinking houseboat, couple and cat, basket hoists
hook: Their houseboat was sinking. Their cat was still aboard.
narration: Their houseboat was sinking, and their cat was still aboard.
It was taking on water on the Scuppernong River in North Carolina.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew from Elizabeth City hovered overhead and lowered a rescue basket.
A basket is the simplest way up. The survivor climbs in and holds on, and the flight mechanic does the rest.
The first person rode it up to the cabin door.
Then the basket went back down for the second.
[short pause] It was one pilot's first real rescue hoist.
A Coast Guard boat crew took the cat instead.
outcome: Both people were flown to an airport, and the boat crew handed the cat back to its owners.
title: Houseboat sinking with their cat aboard
description:
A Coast Guard helicopter crew hoisted two people from a sinking houseboat on the Scuppernong River in Albemarle Sound, N.C., on June 13, 2020, and a boat crew took their cat aboard and returned it to them.
